sloka: व्याकुलावरणा रेजुर्विह्वला इव ता लताः ।। ५.४१.१८।। किसलयैः क्लान्तैः क्लान्तद्रुमलतायुतम् ।।।
transliteration: vyākulāvaraṇā rejurvihvalā iva tā latāḥ ।। 5.41.18।। kisalayaiḥ klāntaiḥ klāntadrumalatāyutam ।।।

translations.english: Vines and trees wilted, birds shrieking, the embankments of ponds destroyed, its tender coppery red shoots withered, the garden looked as though it is burnt by forest fire and the climbers looked like women shivering in fear with their robes disarrayed.
translations.hindi: वह्‌ खंभा सौपहलू था । उसे वे महाबली हनुमान घुमाने लगे। उससे . निकली हुई प्राग की चिनगारियों से वह भवन भस्म हो गया
